parsed.rationale: Two separate `extension Image` declarations appear in the same file `ImageCompatability.swift` at lines 19 and 88 within the `Core` package; these should be merged into a single extension block. Separately, two `extension CGImage` declarations appear in `ArtworkServiceTests.swift` at lines 61 and 91 within the `Artwork` package and should likewise be collapsed. The `CGImage` extensions live in a test file (`Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`), so their consolidation is lower priority but still tidy. The `Image` extensions in production code are the primary target since splitting a single type's extension across multiple declarations in the same file adds unnecessary noise with no structural benefit.
